'''Teelasin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]], who worked as a customs officer on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==Biography==
Teelasin lived on the planet Cularin during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and worked as a customs officer at [[Hedrett Public Transport Facility|Hedrett Groundport]]. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], while she was at work, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] alerted her to the presence of a [[Digby|thief]] in the port's [[Customs Receiving Area]], a large warehouse that was located on the edge of the port.

==Personality and traits==
Teelasin liked to watch romantic [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]].
